package design

import . "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"

var value = Type("OccurrenceValue", func() {
	Attribute("body", Float32, func() { Example(float32(0.1)) })
	Attribute("trace", String)
	Required("body")
	Example(map[string]any{"body": float32(0.1), "trace": "authored"})
})
var _ = Service("svc", func() {
	Method("send", func() {
		Payload(value)
		Result(value)
		HTTP(func() {
			POST("/body")
			Body("body")
			Header("trace")
			Response(StatusOK, func() {
				Header("trace")
			})
		})
	})
})
